lede.zh: 在 4 张 RTX PRO 5000 上测试 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 服务表现。报告覆盖固定长度容量、开放环到达率、长上下文承载与真实 Agent 轨迹回放；每组结果均保留自己的负载口径。
lede.en: This report measures Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 serving on four RTX PRO 5000 GPUs. It covers fixed-length capacity, open-loop arrivals, long-context capacity, and natural Agent trace replay, with each workload kept in its own measurement context.

snapshot.zh: 冻结矩阵完成　/　固定长度、Agent 回放与开放环负载
snapshot.en: Frozen matrix complete　/　fixed length, Agent replay and open-loop load

stats.zhNote: 提示长度，C1/C2 各 32 请求

heading.zh: 吞吐数字附带负载上下文
heading.en: Read capacity with its workload attached

intro.zh: 本页仅报告 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 测试臂。固定长度、开放环和自然 Agent 回放分别测量不同服务行为，数值不能混作同一种负载下的排名。
intro.en: This page covers the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 test arm only. Fixed-length, open-loop, and natural Agent replay measure different serving behaviors and should not be treated as interchangeable scores.

note.zh: 除 8K/512、C1 的三轮锚点外，大多数扩展点为单轮测量。128K 容量点每点 32 个请求，仅作该设置下的观测，不推断稳健尾延迟或普遍容量上限。
note.en: Except for the three-round 8K/512 C1 anchor, most extension points are single runs. Each 128K point has 32 requests and is descriptive for that setting, not a robust tail-latency estimate or general capacity limit.

heading.zh: 并发提升吞吐，长提示限制单路速度
heading.en: Concurrency raises throughput; long prompts constrain per-request speed

intro.zh: 输入与输出长度固定，测量并发变化时整体输出速率。悬停图表可查看实测点；C1 为三轮均值，其他并发点来自扩展轮。
intro.en: Input and output lengths are controlled. The chart shows aggregate output rate as concurrency changes. Hover for measured values; C1 is the mean of three rounds and the other points come from the expanded round.

title.zh: 8K 输入 / 512 输出：整体输出吞吐

hint.zh: 单位 tok/s · C1 为 3 轮均值，其余点为单轮扩展测量
hint.en: tok/s · C1 is a 3-round mean; other points are single expanded measurements

notes.zh: 8K/512 C2 的平均实际输出约为 144 tokens，而非目标 512；该点按实测输出长度解读。C4/C8/C16 与重复锚点不属于同轮，不能把曲线当成重复统计区间。
notes.en: At 8K/512 C2, mean generated output was about 144 tokens rather than the target 512; interpret the point at its observed output length. C4/C8/C16 are from a different round than the repeated anchor and do not form a repeated confidence interval.

heading.zh: 128K 提示词下并发增加，排队延迟随之上升
heading.en: At 128K prompt length, more concurrency raises queueing latency

intro.zh: 长上下文容量点每档 32 个请求。表中展示整体吞吐、请求延迟与首 token 延迟；样本较小，不报告 P95/P99。
intro.en: Long-context capacity points use 32 requests each. The table reports aggregate throughput, request latency, and TTFT; the sample is too small for P95/P99 claims.

title.zh: 长上下文整体输出吞吐

hint.en: Measured points: 64K/512 C1 and 128K/256 C1 and C2

notes.zh: 128K/C2 的请求延迟 P50 约 22 秒，说明该负载下排队明显。报告不将其描述为该硬件的绝对上下文上限。
notes.en: Request latency P50 at 128K/C2 is about 22 seconds, showing substantial queueing for this workload. This is not presented as an absolute context limit for the hardware.

heading.zh: 自然回复长度下的多轮服务表现
heading.en: Multi-turn serving with natural response lengths

intro.zh: 每组回放 16 个会话；Coding 408 个请求，Long-context 437 个请求。外部工具不执行，记录中的工具观察作为上下文回放。
intro.en: Each replay uses 16 sessions: 408 Coding requests and 437 Long-context requests. External tools are not executed; recorded tool observations are replayed as context.

notes.zh: 两个回放集均为请求 100% 完成、错误率 0%。回复长度自然变化，AIPerf 有输出长度不匹配提示；Agent 吞吐不可与固定 512 输出的合成负载直接比较，也不代表任务完成率。
notes.en: Both replays completed all requests with a 0% error rate. Response lengths vary naturally and AIPerf reported output-length mismatches. Agent throughput is not directly comparable to synthetic fixed 512-token output and does not measure task completion.

heading.zh: 到达率超过饱和点后，尾延迟明显抬升
heading.en: Tail latency rises sharply beyond the saturation region

intro.zh: 请求按到达率独立发起，测量客户端发压与服务端完成情况。只呈现 1.0× 和 1.1× 两个高负载点，避免用摘要中未提供的中间值补图。
intro.en: Requests arrive independently of prior completion. This section shows client arrivals and server completion. Only the 1.0× and 1.1× high-load points are shown; no unreported intermediate values are inferred.

title.zh: 目标饱和速率附近的输出吞吐
title.en: Output throughput near the measured saturation rate

hint.zh: 按各自实测 C16 饱和率归一化；不表示固定 req/s
hint.en: Normalized to each arm’s measured C16 saturation rate; not a fixed req/s rate

notes.zh: 所有开放环测点请求错误率均为 0%。到达率从 1.0× 增至 1.1× 时，吞吐增加有限而 P95 延迟上升；P95 是描述性统计，不代表业务 SLO。
notes.en: All open-loop points had a 0% request error rate. Raising arrival rate from 1.0× to 1.1× added little throughput while increasing P95 latency. P95 is descriptive and is not a business SLO.

methodIntro.zh: 测试覆盖 4 卡服务配置；报告展示聚合结果与必要的口径限制。未把精度间差异作为结论，也未声称任务质量等价。
methodIntro.en: The benchmark used a four-GPU serving configuration. This report presents aggregate measurements and their workload limits. It makes no cross-format performance claim and does not claim task-quality equivalence.

value.zh: 仅发布汇总指标；机器地址、主机名、凭据和原始轨迹均未收录
value.en: Aggregated metrics only; host addresses, hostnames, credentials and raw traces excluded

methodNotes.zh: FP8 与 NVFP4 使用不同权重仓库，且 MoE 后端配置不同（FP8 使用运行时默认后端，NVFP4 使用 Marlin）。本页面仅呈现当前权重测试臂，结果只适用于上述硬件、软件版本和负载。
methodNotes.en: FP8 and NVFP4 use different checkpoint repositories and MoE backend configurations (runtime default for FP8, Marlin for NVFP4). This page presents only the selected checkpoint arm; results apply to the listed hardware, software and workloads.

methodNotes.zh: 固定长度点使用 cache-busting system prefix；Agent 回放保留自然共享前缀。没有开展质量评测，因此吞吐结果不代表质量等价。
methodNotes.en: Fixed-length runs use cache-busting system prefixes; Agent replay retains natural shared prefixes. No quality evaluation was run, so throughput results do not establish quality parity.
